title: Check: Structure of the Periodic Table (2) (B)

options.text: An element with properties between metals and non-metals
A non-metal that forms positive ions
A metal that does not conduct electricity

questions.explanation: A metalloid (or semi-metal) is an element with properties intermediate between metals and non-metals. Examples include silicon and germanium. They are found along the 'staircase' in the periodic table and are often semiconductors, making them useful in electronics.
